extension.description: Preview PlantUML diagrams in Markdown and .puml files, include files from your workspace, and export diagrams as SVG or PNG. Rendering runs locally, with no Java, server, or internet connection required.

config.theme.description: Colour scheme for diagram previews. Use "auto" to follow the VS Code colour theme, or choose "light" or "dark". If a diagram's theme or Azure icons would be hard to read, the extension switches that diagram to the other colour scheme.
config.logLevel.description: Minimum severity of rendering messages in the PlantUML Local output channel. This does not affect command logs, such as export messages. VS Code's log level for the channel also filters messages; to see debug messages, set both levels to "debug" or "trace".
config.exportDirectory.description: Folder for exported SVG and PNG files, relative to the Markdown or PlantUML file. Use "." to export to the same folder. Absolute paths and ".." are not allowed.
config.exportTheme.description: Colour scheme for exported SVG and PNG files. Use "light" (the default), "dark", or "preview" to follow the preview setting. If a diagram's theme or Azure icons would be hard to read, the extension switches that diagram to the other colour scheme.
config.exportPngScale.description: Size of exported PNG images: 1, 2, or 4 times the diagram's original size. Export stops if an image would exceed 8192 pixels in width or height, or 16 million pixels in total. Images are not resized automatically.
config.hideExportedImages.description: Hide exported images marked with #plantuml-local in the Markdown preview to avoid showing the same diagram twice. Turn this off to check the exported images.
config.preview.updateMode.description: When to refresh diagrams in Markdown and PlantUML previews: "onChange" as you type, "onSave" when you save, or "manual" when you run PlantUML Local: Clear Render Cache and Re-render. Until then, the preview shows the previous diagram with a notice that it is out of date. New diagrams are always rendered, and exports always use the current source.
config.diagnostics.enabled.description: Show diagram errors and warnings from open Markdown files in the Problems panel, even when no preview is open. This includes unsupported syntax and content that PlantUML leaves out of the diagram.
config.includePaths.description: Additional folders to search for local !include files, after the folder containing the file with the directive. Specify up to 16 paths relative to the workspace folder. These folders are searched for paths such as common.puml or styles/common.puml; paths starting with ./ or ../ are resolved only relative to the file with the directive. Includes require a trusted workspace and must stay within the document's workspace folder.
capability.untrustedWorkspaces.descripti: Diagrams can be previewed in Restricted Mode. Including workspace files and exporting diagrams require a trusted workspace. Rendering runs locally without network access.
capability.virtualWorkspaces.description: Local !include directives require files on disk and are not available in virtual workspaces.
